release: DEVELOPMENT VARIANTS; supplier and physical interfaces remain open
confirmed_requests: Retain existing small machine and add a secondary 4x8 machine
Add RapidChange-style ATC with an approximately USD 700 kit target
Keep the router bed and ATC mounting removable
Repeatably locate the aluminum/HDPE table to the frame
Keep bed conversion within the machine footprint
Preserve the preference for Kraken onboard motor drivers
Use existing fabrication capability and budget-conscious construction
ATC on both machines, retracting on a short linear slide to preserve bed space
working_assumptions_awaiting_user_confir: 4x8 means full 48x96in stock capability, not outside machine dimensions
Large variant uses aluminum framed carrier panels with replaceable HDPE tops; small baseline retains its existing 20100 aluminum bed
Exact RapidChange kit, pocket count and options have not been identified
Treat the proposed 200mm rail as a 200mm useful-stroke target; actual rail length must include bearing blocks and end allowances
Use 50mm combined stock and clamp height above the small bed as a working clearance target, not a user-confirmed maximum
The proposed small-machine retractable ATC revision uses a separately qualified longer Z axis; the original 100mm Z specification is preserved in Rev I

small_atc.strategy: Raised retractable rear tray targets preservation of the nominal 800 x 1000 working rectangle in the proposed longer-Z variant; earlier fixed dock is a historical candidate
small_atc.purchased_axis_status: Y reported on order; X/Z not reported delivered

48x96.strategy: Full sheet with separate dry ATC side bay; redesigned long-axis structure and drives

retractable_atc.onboard_slide_and_shutter_drivers: Kraken S5 slide; S6 large outer shutter. Small closure interface and automatic profile remain unavailable. All require firmware integration and current verification.

accuracy_definition.locators: One round and one relieved/diamond pin in metal bushings per located assembly
accuracy_definition.z_reference: Three primary hard seats; supplementary supports fitted without lifting the datum plane
accuracy_definition.hold_down: Separate positive clamps through metal, not HDPE
accuracy_definition.thermal_design: HDPE allowed to expand relative to aluminum carrier
accuracy_definition.repeatability: A measured acceptance target, not an accuracy guarantee from CAD
accuracy_definition.after_reinstallation: Clean datum surfaces, seat, clamp, verify reference and re-probe as required

procurement.note: Official RapidChange pages show different option pricing. Final kit, freight, tax, tooling and integration cost require a matching cart quote. No complete installed cost is asserted.

limits: Vendor magazine CAD and actual spindle/collet dimensions required before mounting holes or pocket coordinates can be released
The earlier fixed small-machine rear dock reduces routing area; the retractable alternative must also clear full-size stock during tool changes
4x8 purchased motion, structural joints, precision and conversion routes require further engineering
Existing spindle/VFD low-speed reverse and controller M6 integration remain unqualified
An aluminum/HDPE panel on pins alone does not establish machine rigidity
Sand adds mass but is not credited as elastic stiffness
Existing Rev I CAD and qualification records are retained separately
